  _⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_
  
  **Restore the integration-test target contract.**
  
  `make test-integration` is the documented integration-test entrypoint, and `test-integration-baseline` / `test-integration-extended` still route through it. With this change, all of those targets succeed after only printing `JOB_TYPE`, so integration coverage is silently skipped. Keep the existing prerequisites and `test-integration-run`, and put the `JOB_TYPE` experiment behind a separate target if needed.
  
  
  
  
  
  <details>
  <summary>Suggested fix</summary>
  
  ```diff
   .PHONY: test-integration
  -test-integration:
  -	echo $(JOB_TYPE)
  +test-integration: compile-crd-manifests envtest ginkgo dep-crds kueuectl ginkgo-top test-integration-run ## Run integration tests for all singlecluster suites.
  +
  +.PHONY: print-job-type
  +print-job-type:
  +	echo $(JOB_TYPE)
  ```
  </details>
